title: Whatever Happened to Baby J feat. Jodie Sweetin & Drew Seeley
description: An incredible night of throwback FUN featuring Jody Sweetin and Drew Seeley, with Tony winner Marissa Jaret Winokur, Doug Jones, Elisa Donovan, Dale Godboldo, Nate Richert, Garrett Clayton, Romy Rosemont, and Myko Olivier rounding out the cast of fan favorites from the turn of the 21st century!

heroImage.alt: Whatever Happened to Baby J feat. Jodie Sweetin & Drew Seeley

blocks.html: What a night! We were honored to sponsor an evening supporting AIDS Resource Foundation for Children with a Live Table Read of "Whatever Happened to Baby J" - a new Y2K boyband-obsessed story written by award-winning screenwriter Victoria Male!

An incredible night of throwback FUN featured Jody Sweetin and Drew Seeley. They were joined by Tony winner Marissa Jaret Winokur, Doug Jones, Elisa Donovan, Dale Godboldo, Nate Richert, Garrett Clayton, Romy Rosemont, and Myko Olivier. This talented cast brought back memories for fans of the turn of the 21st century!

The event was a full-sensory, Y2K-themed experience. Attendees embraced the millennial nostalgia, dressing in their best throwback looks. The energy in the room was infectious! Guests enjoyed original music from Grammy-nominee Yan Perchuk. A raffle kept the excitement going, and the event was live-streamed globally through Dynasty Typewriter's service, "Transmissions by Dynasty".

In “What Ever Happened to Baby J?”, Olivia Hughes discovers a shocking secret. Her shy, stay-at-home husband, Robbie, was once part of a huge millennial boy band. When he goes missing, Olivia must team up with his former bandmates to find him. Time is running out as Robbie faces the worst nightmare of his life—a reunion tour that he never wanted.
This captivating plot twist filled the evening with suspense and a touch of humor. The audience was taken on a journey through Robbie's past and Olivia's determination to bring him back.
In case you missed it, you can still catch the replay of the livestream for a limited time.

We invite everyone to stay connected with us for future events. Participating in community initiatives is essential. Supporting causes like the AIDS Resource Foundation for Children is crucial. It helps those in need while keeping our memories alive through fun entertainment.
Plus, who doesn’t love a good Y2K throwback? The lights, the music, and the company make for unforgettable nights. Join us as we continue these thrilling nostalgic events!
Feel free to check out our upcoming events and get involved. Together, we can make a difference while celebrating our shared histories.
As we move forward, we also look back. Every decade offers unique experiences. The 80s and 90s are just as exciting! Look forward to themed nights that capture those eras.
Consider how much joy these themes bring to all of us. Each event offers not just entertainment but also a reminder of how far we've come. Let's continue to create more lasting memories together.
Let’s make sure you don’t miss out next time! Grab your friends and dress up for a night out. The Y2K experience is one for the books, and we can't wait to see you again!
Together, we can relive those incredible moments and support worthy causes. Keep an eye on our updates and we’ll let you know when the next adventure begins.
